schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to rank. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

branch.description: Landing branch whose verified history supplies evidence.

workspace.description: Owning Orbit workspace (ws_* id or name). Required for task_id lookup and hybrid search.

query.description: Free-text change description. Send exactly one of query or task_id.

task_id.description: Orbit task id whose public text is the query. Send exactly one of query or task_id.

task_snapshot.description: Earlier public task snapshot to use instead of a live orbit.task.show observation; required for strict replay without task callbacks.

level.description: Result granularity: file for a change surface, symbol for implementation navigation.

revision.description: Target commit or ref to rank against; defaults to the checkout HEAD.

cutoff.description: Timestamp (RFC 3339 with an offset, or unix:<seconds>) for strict historical replay: only evidence and task text attested before it are used.

hybrid.description: Also rank similar tasks through the public orbit.search tool; failures fall back to local lexical ranking and are named in adapter.warnings.

hybrid_limit.description: Maximum orbit.search hits requested when hybrid is true.

hybrid_hits.description: Pre-ranked task hits to merge instead of, or in addition to, a live orbit.search call.

task_id.description: Task id of one ranked hit.

score.description: Non-negative relevance score of the hit.
